{{Top|leg}}
'''Claron''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] and a subscriber to [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]. Claron commented on the entry for the [[2-ZH surgical droid]], relating that the mercenary unit they worked with used one of the droids, and that a shipment of them had been hijacked near [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]].<ref name="CDD">{{JournalCite|13|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref>
